Project: SIS App Intelligence

Purpose:
Analyze SIS source code,
database metadata,
stored procedures,
and business documents.

Tech Stack:
- Java 21
- Spring Boot 4.1.1
- PostgreSQL
- Maven

Architecture:
controller
service
repository
entity

Rules:

Use constructor injection.

Use Lombok.

Do not overengineer.

Keep MVP simple.

Favor readability over abstraction.

Generate production quality code.
